business_problem: Recognizing the need to adapt to rapid advancements in AI, the South Australia Department for Education wanted to embrace the transformative potential of generative AI technologies in the classroom.
solution_summary: The South Australia Department for Education, in partnership with Microsoft, launched 'EdChat,' a generative AI-powered educational chatbot, to safely incorporate AI technology into classrooms. Recognizing the need to adapt to rapid advancements in AI, the South Australia Department for Education wanted to embrace the transformative potential of generative AI technologies in the classroom. Protecting students from potentially harmful or inappropriate content was a core concern for the South Australia Department for Education. The Department launched a pilot program to gauge the effectiveness of EdChat, involving approximately 1,500 students and 150 teachers from eight secondary schools over an initial eight-week trial period. The implementation centers on Azure AI Content Safety, Azure to support security and compliance workflows.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Content Safety
solution_components.role: Screens prompts and outputs to enforce safety guardrails in the deployed experience.

solution_components.name: Azure
solution_components.role: Provides the underlying cloud infrastructure, identity, and managed services for the solution.
